raw.query: SELECT d.lead_s, MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE d.policy='reactive') AS reactive_p99_ms, BOOL_AND(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE d.policy='reactive') AS reactive_violates, MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE d.policy='forecast') AS forecast_p99_ms, BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE d.policy='forecast') AS forecast_violates FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_infraction i USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND i.is_current AND d.experiment='a2' AND d.window_name='burst3' AND d.policy IN ('reactive','forecast') AND i.sla_metric='encoder_delay' AND i.bound_stat='p99' GROUP BY d.lead_s ORDER BY d.lead_s
raw.observed: leads 15/30/45/165: reactive violates at all 4 (p99 9481/16079/28342/54170 ms), forecast passes at all 4 (p99 588 ms); n=1 per lead, no superseded rows
